January, 2023

Bench: Sunita Agarwal, Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 39
Case :- Writ - C No. - 36887 of 2022
Petitioner :- Ajeet Kumar Shankhdhar
Respondent :- State Of U P And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- B.K.Singh Raghuvanshi,Akash Chaubey

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.

The petitioner herein seeks direction commanding the respondents to decide his objection in relation to the land in question which has been shown as agricultural land in the acquisition notifications issued by the State Government in the year 2021 and to prepare award of the land in question for payment of compensation as non agricultural land and further restrain the respondents from taking physical possession in the land in question.

In none of the paragraphs of the writ petition there is any disclosure of acquisition notification under the relevant provisions of Land Acquisition Act in relation to the plot in question which is plot no. 1110 area 0.1740 hectares.
It is sought to be submitted that an educational institution being run by the petitioner is existing over the said plot which has not been shown in the notification of acquisition.

sentences.text: There is no document of entry of the education institution over the plot in question, even the name of the institution has not been disclosed herein.
There is no challenge to the acquisition notifications, which according to the petitioner, mention the incorrect nature of the property in question, as agricultural land.
For the incomplete facts on record, no direction can be given.
The writ petition is found to be misconceived.

At this stage, the learned counsel for the petitioner prays for and is permitted to withdraw the present writ petition with liberty to file fresh petition with better particulars.
In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as aforesaid.
Order Date :- 12.1.2023
